verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a vector database, but the evidence shows no way to self-host Pinecone's core product. The only local option, Pinecone Local (an in-memory emulator), has reached end of life. The remaining Prism-based mock is a request/response test stub that does not cover real search, so it does not count as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
